description: Escalate the existing Compliance Finding 'Unpatched Legacy Payment Server' into the Risk Register. Create a new Risk titled 'Risk: Legacy Payment Server Vulnerabilities' with the description 'The payment server runs an EOL operating system that cannot be patched. This increases the likelihood of compromise via known exploits. Retained due to legacy software dependency.' Set appropriate Likelihood and Impact scores (e.g., High/High). critically, you must LINK the new Risk to the existing 'Unpatched Legacy Payment Server' finding using the Relations/Mappings tab.
